verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents built-in, AI-driven browser agents (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, BrowserUse) that run in its managed cloud sessions. A user can delegate a task with a single API call and watch it execute live, and HyperAgent's page.ai() accepts natural-language tasks. However, delegation is API/SDK-driven browser automation rather than a conversational assistant inside the product interface. Missing for 10: an in-product assistant UI (dashboard chat or console) for delegating tasks, delegation beyond browser tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated agent tasks work.
